description.value: Cactus Club Cafe is a well-established Canadian chain serving an upscale casual menu of international dishes — steaks, sushi, pasta, and inventive cocktails — in a stylish, high-energy setting. The West Broadway location sits at a busy urban intersection and is part of a large multi-city network, offering full sit-down dining as well as takeout and delivery. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a broad menu with something for most tastes and the convenience of curbside pickup.
